## Case studies

- [Adaptive Assignment Engine](/work/adaptive-assignment-engine): Edfora, Senior Product Manager. A fixed practice sequence was the wrong difficulty for many learners. Adaptive practice built on a 3PL Item Response Theory (IRT) model: the engine estimated each learner's ability (θ) per concept, selected questions by P(θ) from their difficulty, discrimination and guessing parameters, and updated θ after each response. Assignment completion increased from 18% to 45% across live learning cohorts (+27 percentage points); practice drop-offs reduced.
- [Onboarding Funnel Redesign](/work/onboarding-funnel-redesign): Witzeal Technologies (real-money gaming), Product Manager. Only about 35% of new users reached gameplay on their first day (D0); the onboarding journey was lengthy, with OTP friction an important part of it. The redesign simplified signup and login, fetched the email ID automatically, added OTP auto-read, gave new users their first 3 games free and added a live gameplay tutorial. In a 3-week controlled rollout (30% control, 70% treatment, about 50K users), Day-7 retention was 12.2% in control and 25.4% in treatment, +13.2 percentage points.
- [AI Learner Diagnostic](/work/ai-learner-diagnostic): Independent portfolio prototype, not shipped at any employer and with no real users, production adoption or model results. Shows the rules vs. model split, grounding, failure modes and fallbacks, evaluation rubric, confidence UX and teacher override.

## Other documented outcomes

- Edfora: quiz and gamification layer, designed around teachers who found early prototypes "too game-y": DAU up ~12–15%, average session time up ~15%.
- Edfora: real-time engagement dashboards for faculty replaced a monthly spreadsheet pull: student retention up ~8–12%. Learning and engagement products reached 100K+ learners.
- Witzeal: experimentation roadmap across pricing and reward loops: GMV growth ~10% week over week. Bonus allocation by expected ROI per segment: bonus spend down ~20% with retention held. Segmented lifecycle messaging: long-term retention stabilized at 48%.
- Baazi Games (PokerBaazi, Lagai Khai, FanBlaze): 20+ A/B tests, core funnel conversion up ~15%; behavioral segmentation, session duration up ~35% and retention up ~25%; rules-based fraud detection, fraud losses down ~18%.
- PwC India, Program & Release Manager: release process for a web application deployed to 150+ Fortune companies.
- Direct Create, Android Developer (2014–2018), not a product management role: sole Android developer; built the app from scratch and proposed one app with role selection for makers, buyers and designers instead of separate apps. Platform scale: 400+ maker shops and 100+ designers.
